Conclusion: The test `pandas.tests.groupby.test_apply.test_apply_datetime_issue` checks whether the `GroupBy.apply` method correctly handles cases where the DataFrame contains a datetime object column with non-standard integer labels. However, the test failure indicates that this is not the case. Following the execution path, we find that the error occurs in line 714 of the `pandas.core.groupby.groupby._GroupBy.apply` method. Here, `np.errstate(all="ignore")` is used to ignore any numpy errors that might occur during the application of the function `func`. However, this context manager seems to be causing an issue when the function being applied involves indexing with a non-standard integer label (42 in this case), leading to a `KeyError`.

Methods to fix:

pandas.core.groupby.groupby._GroupBy.apply
```
